9// Run with: bin/coinalgebra -l -b -q tests/core/test_coin.C
10// Or run scripts/test_coincidences.sh for both native and ROOT checks.
11namespace {
12void coin_check(bool condition, const char* expression) {
13    if (!condition) throw std::runtime_error(std::string("FAIL: ") + expression);
14}
15#define COIN_CHECK(expression) coin_check((expression), #expression)
16
17template<class F> void rejects(F f) {
18    bool rejected = false;
19    try { f(); } catch (const std::invalid_argument&) { rejected = true; }
20    COIN_CHECK(rejected);
21}
22void close(double a, double b) { COIN_CHECK(std::abs(a-b) < 1e-12); }
23}
24void test_coin() {
25    std::cout << "Testing DecayCoin and CAlgebra\n";
26    DecayQuiver q;
27    auto* a=q.AddLevel("a"); auto* b=q.AddLevel("b");
28    auto* c=q.AddLevel("c"); auto* d=q.AddLevel("d");
29    auto* e=q.AddLevel("e"); auto* f=q.AddLevel("f");
30    auto* ab=q.AddTransition("ab",a,b);
31    auto* bc=q.AddTransition("bc",b,c);
32    auto* cd=q.AddTransition("cd",c,d);
33    auto* bd=q.AddTransition("bd",b,d);
34    auto* de=q.AddTransition("de",d,e);
35    auto* ef=q.AddTransition("ef",e,f);
36    auto* ac=q.AddTransition("ac",a,c);
37    auto* parallel=q.AddTransition("ab2",a,b);
38    std::vector<DecayLevel*> order{a,b,c,d,e,f};
39    DecayVector decay;
40    decay.AddTerm(DecayPath(*bc),0.5);
41    decay.AddTerm(DecayPath(*cd),0.4);
42    decay.AddTerm(DecayPath(*bd),0.3);
43    decay.AddTerm(DecayPath(a),100.0); // feeding is excluded from c_d
44    CAlgebra algebra(q,order,decay);
45    auto A=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*ab});
46    auto D=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*de});
47    auto E=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*ef});
48    auto gap=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*de,*ab});
49    COIN_CHECK(gap.Degree()==2 && gap.GetSource()==a && gap.GetTarget()==e);
50    COIN_CHECK(gap==A.Compose(D));
51    std::cout << "PASS: unordered gapped coincidence, degree and endpoints (Eq. 40)\n";
52    close(algebra.ScalarConnection(A,D),0.5); // 0.3 + 0.5*0.4
53    close(algebra.ScalarConnection(D,E),1.0);
54    COIN_CHECK(algebra.Multiply(D,A).empty());
55    COIN_CHECK(algebra.Multiply(A,A).empty());
56    rejects([&]{ algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*ab,*ab}); });
57    rejects([&]{ algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*ab,*parallel}); });
58    rejects([&]{ algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*ac,*bd}); });
59    rejects([&]{ algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayPath>{DecayPath(*ac),DecayPath(b)}); });
60    std::cout << "PASS: connections, reversed products, repeated/parallel/crossing transitions\n";
61    auto source=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayPath>{DecayPath(a)});
62    auto target=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayPath>{DecayPath(b)});
63    COIN_CHECK(source.Degree()==0 && source.IsStationary());
64    COIN_CHECK(source.Compose(A)==A && A.Compose(target)==A);
65    COIN_CHECK(source.Compose(source)==source);
66    auto marked=algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayPath>{DecayPath(a),DecayPath(*de)});
67    COIN_CHECK(marked.GetFactors().size()==2 && marked.Degree()==1);
68    auto path=DecayPath(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*de,*ef});
69    COIN_CHECK(algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayPath>{path})==D.Compose(E));
70    std::cout << "PASS: stationary identities, separated stationary factors and path embedding\n";
71    auto left=algebra.Multiply(algebra.Multiply(A,D),CAlgebra::Vector{{E,1.0}});
72    auto right=algebra.Multiply(CAlgebra::Vector{{A,1.0}},algebra.Multiply(D,E));
73    COIN_CHECK(left.size()==1 && right.size()==1 && left[0].coin==right[0].coin);
74    close(left[0].coefficient,right[0].coefficient);
75    CAlgebra zero(q,order,DecayVector{});
76    COIN_CHECK(zero.Multiply(A,D).empty()); // valid basis, zero connection
77    close(zero.ScalarConnection(D,E),1.0);
78    auto squared=algebra.Power({{A,2.0},{D,3.0}},2);
79    COIN_CHECK(squared.size()==1 && squared[0].coin==gap);
80    close(squared[0].coefficient,3.0);
81    rejects([&]{ algebra.Power({},0); });
82    rejects([&]{ CAlgebra bad(q,{a,b,c},decay); });
83    rejects([&]{ CAlgebra bad(q,{f,e,d,c,b,a},decay); });
84    DecayTransition foreign("foreign",a,b);
85    rejects([&]{ algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{foreign}); });
86    // Bilinearity, term collection, cancellation and scalar coefficients.
87    auto distributed=algebra.Multiply(CAlgebra::Vector{{A,2.0},{A,1.0}},
88                                      CAlgebra::Vector{{D,4.0}});
89    COIN_CHECK(distributed.size()==1 && distributed[0].coin==gap);
90    close(distributed[0].coefficient,6.0);
91    COIN_CHECK(algebra.Multiply(CAlgebra::Vector{{A,1.0},{A,-1.0}},
92                               CAlgebra::Vector{{D,1.0}}).empty());
93    auto embedded=algebra.Embed(DecayVector(path,0.25));
94    COIN_CHECK(embedded.size()==1 && embedded[0].coin==D.Compose(E));
95    close(embedded[0].coefficient,0.25);
96    auto cubed=algebra.Power({{A,2.0},{D,3.0},{E,4.0}},3);
97    COIN_CHECK(cubed.size()==1 && cubed[0].coin==gap.Compose(E));
98    close(cubed[0].coefficient,12.0);
99    std::cout << "PASS: weighted vector products, cancellation, powers and invalid inputs\n";
100    // Associativity across transitions, stationary factors and gapped tensors.
101    std::vector<DecayCoin> basis{A,D,E,gap,marked};
102    for (auto* level : order)
103        basis.push_back(algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayPath>{DecayPath(level)}));
104    for (auto* edge : q.GetTransitions())
105        basis.push_back(algebra.Coin(std::vector<DecayTransition>{*edge}));
106    for (const auto& x : basis) for (const auto& y : basis) for (const auto& z : basis) {
107        auto lhs=algebra.Multiply(algebra.Multiply(x,y),CAlgebra::Vector{{z,1.0}});
108        auto rhs=algebra.Multiply(CAlgebra::Vector{{x,1.0}},algebra.Multiply(y,z));
109        COIN_CHECK(lhs.size()==rhs.size());
110        if (!lhs.empty()) {
111            COIN_CHECK(lhs.front().coin==rhs.front().coin);
112            close(lhs.front().coefficient,rhs.front().coefficient);
113        }
114    }
115    std::cout << "PASS: associativity for " << basis.size()*basis.size()*basis.size()
116              << " basis triples\n";
117    COIN_CHECK(DecayCoin{}.Empty());
118    COIN_CHECK(algebra.Multiply(DecayCoin{},A).empty());
119    std::cout << "PASS: empty sentinel and zero products\nAll coincidence tests passed.\n";
120}
